pre_run_amendments.rationale: The original content-only temporal transformer had no explicit sequence-order signal. The fixed-G1 and later LORO path should test the order-aware architecture rather than preserve that known weakness.

scientific_question: Can the existing SNMR human temporal encoder plus the identity-free kinematic RobotSpec graph decoder amortize the fixed Unitree G1 GMR teacher without losing human-side semantics, before morphology diversity or dynamics conditioning is introduced?

canonical_alignment.human_contact_interpolation: linear after source-side probabilistic contact derivation
canonical_alignment.rationale: Exact shared timestamps are essential. Cubic root translation matches the HumanMotionSpec Euclidean-position contract; linear scalar joints preserve the source interval and joint limits; SLERP preserves unit rotations.
canonical_alignment.forbidden_legacy_path: scripts/export_wbt_npz.py::resample_qpos uses linspace over the duration and generally does not produce an exact 0.02 s grid; it must not define training alignment.
required_checks: human and teacher timestamps are bitwise/effectively identical
last source sample is included only when source duration lies on the 50 Hz grid
shared 30/50 Hz timestamps every 0.1 s reproduce source samples within frozen tolerance
root quaternions are canonicalized continuous unit wxyz
linear joint targets remain within RobotSpec limits
HumanMotionSpec and CanonicalTeacherMotion hashes are saved for every clip

overfit_window.selection: Adapt the entire source clip to HumanMotionSpec and CanonicalTeacherMotion, then take canonical target indices [0,128).
overfit_window.reason: The clip and start are selected before observing the new model. Full-clip adaptation preserves source provenance and avoids an ad-hoc source slice whose target count depends on endpoint arithmetic.

root_contract.xy_scale_derivation: Least-squares fit on all canonical 50 Hz frames of the 70 training clips: sum_t dot(robot_root_xy, human_root_xy) / sum_t squared_norm(human_root_xy). No validation frames are used.
root_contract.anchor_definition: anchor_xy_t = xy_scale * human_root_xy_t; anchor_z is zero for localization/reconstruction; anchor heading is the yaw extracted from the full human root quaternion.
root_contract.teacher_local_position: p_local_t = R_yaw(human_t)^T * (p_robot_t - [xy_scale*h_x_t, xy_scale*h_y_t, 0]); local z is therefore absolute world z.
root_contract.teacher_local_orientation: q_local_t = conjugate(q_yaw(human_t)) multiply q_robot_t, package wxyz convention.
root_contract.prediction_requirement: The model predicts local XYZ and local orientation from human tokens plus pooled identity-free robot embeddings. Ground-truth root values may not be copied or teacher-forced at evaluation.
root_contract.future_holdout_warning: xy_scale is target-qpos-derived G1 calibration. It is valid only for this fixed-G1 compatibility experiment and must not be used for held-out T1. Before LORO, use an identity-free graph-conditioned root displacement/velocity formulation or another preregistered target-supervision-free anchor.

human_input.dynamic_feature_layout: heading-local position 3 + local rotation 6D 6 + one-frame local displacement 3
human_input.static_feature_layout: rest offset 3 + zero human joint axis 3 + has_dof 1 + end-effector 1
human_input.velocity_note: The reused feature is displacement per canonical 50 Hz frame, not meters per second. This is internally consistent for the frozen 50 Hz corpus but makes old 30 Hz encoder weights distribution-mismatched.

robot_graph_config.joint_output: one shared scalar head per joint-bearing child-link token followed by tanh joint-limit parameterization

model.root_head: Pooled valid robot embeddings concatenate with each human time token; shared MLP emits local position 3 plus rotation 6D, converted to unit wxyz.
model.contact_policy: Contacts are derived from predicted robot sole FK under the registered contact protocol. They are not copied from GMR and no learned contact head is required for this gate.
model.teacher_joint_mapping: CanonicalTeacherMotion joint_names follow RobotSpec.joints. Training must scatter/gather each joint through its JointSpec child link and the token audit metadata. It must not assume token serialization index equals qpos joint index.

provisional_g1_binding.note: This measured binding uses the currently available G1 SemanticManifest with head_link absent. It is suitable for the overfit wiring test but must be regenerated after the final semantic-head convention is frozen.

distill.definition: mean squared local root position + mean squared 29-DoF joint position + mean squared root rotation-matrix entries

joint_limits.definition: squared excess outside limits; expected exactly zero because output is bounded by construction

smoothness.definition: second finite differences of joint positions and local root position plus 0.1 times joint-position third finite differences

loss.reason: The first experiment isolates fixed-target decoder integration and GMR amortization. Human-side semantic/contact metrics are evaluation rulers, not extra teacher channels.

optimization.random_sampling: uniform over the 70 training clips, then uniform valid canonical window start within the selected clip
optimization.checkpoint_selection: fixed endpoint only; periodic validation is monitoring and may not select a best checkpoint

overfit.failure_action: Stop. Diagnose target mapping, root frame, masks, loss, or decoder integration. Do not add morphology diversity, dynamics, contact objectives, or physics.

bounded_screen.interpretation: Promotion screen only. Passing does not establish semantic non-inferiority. A failing screen localizes integration/optimization trouble before a full run.

fixed_g1_qualification.run_policy: fresh preregistered run from scratch after the screen passes and final semantic calibration is frozen
fixed_g1_qualification.primary_metric: per-clip keypoint_error_normalized_mean from snmr.semantic_metrics, graph model and GMR independently evaluated against HumanMotionSpec
report_required: all semantic metrics for GMR and graph model on the same human ruler
root displacement, heading, and height errors
contact probability, timing disagreement, and transition timing
teacher-relative FK/DoF compatibility metrics as secondary diagnostics
motion amplitude, energy, and jitter guards

full_sequence_evaluation.window_starts: 0,64,... plus max(T-128,0) if the tail-aligned start is not already present
full_sequence_evaluation.blend_joint_and_root_position: normalized weighted arithmetic mean; convex joint blending preserves limits
full_sequence_evaluation.blend_root_orientation: canonicalize each quaternion sign to the first contribution at that frame, take the normalized weighted quaternion mean, then canonicalize temporal signs
full_sequence_evaluation.frame_aggregation: evaluate every canonical frame once after stitching; compute per-clip metrics first, then aggregate clips
stitching_diagnostics: joint and root first-difference magnitude at seams versus non-seams
joint and root second-difference magnitude at seams versus non-seams

root_and_contact_requirements.why_root_is_required: Teacher-side root substitution would leak the target and invalidate root displacement, heading, height, world FK, and robot-contact measurements.
root_and_contact_requirements.why_contact_head_is_not_required: Human contact probabilities are hash-bound and derived in HumanMotionSpec; robot contacts are independently derived from predicted sole FK.
